methodology.warning: Inspector CPU sampling of unminified ESM; this is not a throughput ranking or a causal attribution of the competitor gap.

candidate.description: Internal RPC follow-up, 13 November 2026; API/wire unchanged.

methodology.topology: MessageChannel, two endpoints in one event loop; worker startup/scheduling excluded
methodology.payload: Identical structured-cloned objects; every returned scalar/text checked; remote echo invocation counts verified after timing
methodology.order: Rotate library order each round; repeat this suite in fresh processes
methodology.diagnostic: Rows labelled no budget disable only that guard on controlled test data; they are excluded from production performance comparisons.
methodology.guarantees: Non-diagnostic CrossBus cases retain default payload/request limits, peer binding and timeout. Comlink has no per-call timeout; birpc defaults to 60s; Penpal default has none, plus a cached 30s-timeout variant. API semantics differ.
